recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Keith Parker is the founder of Field Dynamics, an energy healing modality built on understanding the actual mechanics of how the human energy field works, not a proprietary system like Reiki, but a universal, open framework he describes as the Linux of energy healing.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In this episode: why consciousness creates matter and not the other way around; why science has no idea what the mind actually is; how thoughts are literally frequencies moving through your field; the convertibility between information and energy; why every paradigm shift inverts the one before it; and Keith's concept of "cosmedics", the idea that the internet is a low-resolution copy of how consciousness has always functioned.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "One Pattern, Infinite Diversity", "body": "Chance frames the question and answer process as a dendritic fractal, the same branching found in lightning, rivers, blood vessels and tree limbs, and links pater, the All Father, to pattern itself. Keith answers with Stephen Wolfram, who spent years combing the scientific literature and concluded that repeating one simple line of code endlessly yields the diversity of an entire universe. He reads the Taoist yin yang the same way, a circle of infinity split into interacting polarities, the same splitting the cosmic egg stories describe as the birth of time and space, one thing reappearing across every scale of the Mandelbrot zoom."}, {"title": "The Self That Might Be Time", "body": "Chance proposes, by way of Kant's transcendental idealism, that the deepest self may be time itself, the temporal process that changes inner attending and outer attention, bounded like the recursive witness loop he connects to Godel's incompleteness and the ring around Saturn. Keith responds with his time, space, mind, body analog: as electricity is conjoined with magnetism and time with space, mind is conjoined with body, and in his view the aura, being the structure of mind, is therefore the structure of time. Chance adds that in his own biofield work the aura reads temporally in layers, like the rings of a tree."}, {"title": "A Brain Built for Higher Dimensions", "body": "Keith leans on the Blue Brain Project in Switzerland, the most extensive brain mapping effort yet, where a supercomputer fed massive amounts of rat brain data concluded that synaptic firings coordinate through higher dimensional geometry, from the fourth up through the eleventh dimension. The researchers drew no metaphysical conclusion, but Keith argues it means the brain is not the mind at all: it is the interface through which higher dimensional electromagnetic information systems engage the material realm. He maps this onto his energy anatomy, where chakras are geometries organizing the field's dimensions, the geometric light body inverse to the fluid, kaleidoscopic astral."}, {"title": "An Ecology of Unseen Life", "body": "Asked what entity attachments actually are, Keith describes an ecology of consciousness as populated as the gut microbiome. Some entities are self-made thought forms, like chronic anger concretized until it feels foreign, while others feed on an imbalanced field the way microbes feed on what you eat. He locates this activity on the astral plane, the plasma layer at the heart chakra sandwiched between body and mind. Chance counters the fear framing, suggesting non-corporeal life may be pleomorphic like bacteria, adapting to clean up imbalance rather than hunting anyone, and Keith agrees: none of it matters more than doing the work in front of you."}, {"title": "Erasing the I From I Am", "body": "Keith reverse engineers identity: strip Parker, the ancestry, then Keith, the personality, and I am remains; erase the I and only am is left, pure beingness like a light switched on in an empty room, with the void when it is off. Pushed to the paradox of why anything exists, Chance brings Jung's Seven Sermons to the Dead, where all things combined with their opposites cancel into the Pleroma yet effectiveness remains, and lands on the observation that non-existence doesn't exist. Keith, placing himself firmly in the non-dual camp, closes with the difference between a personality purpose and a soul purpose, contentment following whoever listens to that deeper guidance."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "Until you're ready to ask the question, you're not going to understand the answer anyway.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If we exist inside this sort of self-created recursive awareness loop or ring, then even though that constitutes a limitation, it actually provides the structure for infinite potential.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Whatever you think you are, there's a ring that inhibits your sense of self from expanding further.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You can't have magnetism without electricity. You can't have time without space, and you can't have mind without body.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When you just put it in simple terms, non-existence doesn't exist.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Hologram means in all parts the whole. So that means that all the information in the entire universe is quite literally non-locally embedded into every single place in time and space.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Whatever nature is, it's going to respond to where there's imbalance with an effect that corrects it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Just do the work you need to do that's hitting you right in the nose, and that's how people know what's next for them in general.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "At the astral, thoughts are things, and things are thoughts.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I do think we have, not deterministic purposes, but there is a soul purpose rather than a personality purpose.", "author": "Keith Parker", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/6ea0c477-44a7-4b1e-9128-e5c698516d27/KEITH-PARKER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
